card.name: The word wild in nature contexts
card.fires_on: The word "wild" (also the start of the name Wilder), mostly in phrases like "in the wild", "wild game", "wild boar" and "wild birds".

modes.label: Wild as animals or plants
modes.description: "wild" describes animals or plants living in nature, before a noun or after "the".
modes.example: The adult frogs are totally land-based and don’t have webbed feet. In the<< wild>> the eggs are laid on the forest floor

modes.label: Start of a surname
modes.description: "Wild" begins the name Wilder, in a literary context.
modes.example: This is a suggested teaching schedule for a 10 day class study of Thornton<< Wild>>er's The Bridge of San Luis Rey

card.writes: It promotes wild-related words (wild, 野生) but the other tokens are mixed, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "wild" when talking about animals or plants living in nature.
